- hiring_mistake_if_wrong: 0.55
- average_rep_salary: 140000
- candidate_a_salary: 180000
- hiring_mistake_cost: 150000
- incremental_commission_cost: 10000

- hire_candidate_a: Hire Candidate A — Extend full-time offer to Candidate A.
- continue_search: Continue Search — Keep interviewing other candidates.

ACTION: <one action id from the list>
CLAIM: <one sentence stating the strongest claim the evidence supports for this action>
CONFIDENCE: <number between 0 and 1>
